subject: Cloaker
picture: A large flying cloaker in a dungeon hall. Official look: it is a flying manta ray that also reads as a spread cloak. About eight feet across. Dark leathery back. Pale underside with two eyes and a toothy mouth in the cowl. One long whip tail trailing behind. Two small ivory claw-clasps near the head that look like cloak fasteners. Nobody is wearing it. It is in the air, wings unfurled. Stone ceiling, block walls, large floor slabs, closed wooden door. Bold even black outlines on white, same look as locked I-01 and I-02. All-ages, no gore.
